title: P18-A canonical objective_relation — the coordination layer's atomic fact between objectives in one business
description: P18-A: canonical objective_relation + ObjectiveRelationService — substrate for portfolio/parallel/handoff/duties/recovery. Closed kind vocabulary (DEPENDS_ON, CONFLICTS, SUPERSEDES); ACTIVE→SUSPENDED⇄ACTIVE→REVOKED (terminal, idempotent); closed action vocabulary validated before the transition map. Bilateral authority: actor = operator:<ref> must equal owner_authority_id of BOTH endpoints at mint/control AND row re-proof re-checks created_by against CURRENT owners (amended endpoint drops the relation). business_id derived from canonical objectives; endpoints resolved via strict ObjectiveAuthorityService.get. DEPENDS_ON acyclicity at mint AND RESUME over non-REVOKED edges (SUSPENDED counts). Idempotent mint per (from,to,kind) non-terminal; dedup after authority. create()/control() fully inside store.immediate — dedup/cycle read + put + event commit or roll back together (no orphans, cross-connection serialization). Digest pins canonical fields; OCC on column version. Reads enumerate via entityPage (payload.entity_id bound to storage key — anchor-borrowing clones rejected at the page; isolate-and-skip keeps legit page-mates). Re-proof: digest + key↔identity binding + strict endpoints + business consistency + bilateral current-owner + FULL event tail — CREATED first with matching identity pins, every STATE hop a legal transition chaining from prior new_state, ending at row state. Resurrections, chain breaks, event-less forges, foreign pairings, tampered keys never served. upstreamOf dedup'd. P18-A inert: no admission/scheduling/UI consumer. Codex-only.
